snippet.title: I Want to Play the Villain! — Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
This is no ordinary theatre. Every actor has their own wishes, ambitions, and fears — and it’s up to you to arrange the perfect cast. Can you create the perfect show?

I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game where every character on stage has their own personality. Rearrange the cast, switch costumes, and change the story to give every actor their perfect role.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4831430/I_Want_to_Play_the_Villain/

Demo coming August 17, 2026

Features:
• Solve clever theatre-themed logic puzzles
• Explore unique chapters, each with its own setting, characters, mechanics, and story
• Change modular stories to create different performances and outcomes
• Learn each actor’s personality, preferences, ambitions, and fears to solve increasingly challenging puzzles
Every performance is different. Every chapter, a new puzzle. A single change can transform the entire show.

#PuzzleGame #IndieGame #TheatreGame #LogicPuzzle
